dialogue.text: Today in History
dialogue.zh: 今天的歷史
dialogue.ja: 今日は歴史の日です
dialogue.local: Today in History
dialogue.en: Today in History

dialogue.text: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.
dialogue.zh: 8月12日，IBM推出了個人電腦，並加速了個人電腦革命。
dialogue.ja: 8月12日、IBMはパーソナルコンピュータを発表し、PC革命を加速させました。
dialogue.local: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.
dialogue.en: August 12, IBM introduced the Personal Computer and accelerated the PC Revolution.

dialogue.text: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.
dialogue.zh: 1981年8月12日，IBM正式推出了被稱為Model 5150的IBM個人電腦。
dialogue.ja: 1981年8月12日、IBMはModel 5150として知られるIBMパーソナルコンピュータを正式に発表しました。
dialogue.local: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.
dialogue.en: On August 12, 1981, IBM officially introduced the IBM Personal Computer, known as the Model 5150.

dialogue.text: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.
dialogue.zh: 在IBM進入市場之前，個人電腦已經存在，蘋果、康懋達、坦迪、Radio Shack等公司已經為消費者和愛好者生產了機器。
dialogue.ja: IBMが市場に参入する前から、Apple、Commodore、Tandy、Radio Shackなどの企業が消費者や趣味者向けのパソコンを製造していました。
dialogue.local: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.
dialogue.en: Personal computers already existed before IBM entered the market, Apple, Commodore, Tandy, Joe Radio Shack, and other companies had already produced machines for consumers and hobbyists.

dialogue.text: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.
dialogue.zh: IBM的重要性不同。這家世界上最強大且受尊敬的電腦公司之一進入了個人電腦市場，為這項技術帶來了巨大的影響力。
dialogue.ja: IBMの重要性は異なりました。世界で最も強力で尊敬されるコンピュータ企業の一つがパーソナルコンピュータ市場に参入し、その技術に大きな信頼を与えました。
dialogue.local: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.
dialogue.en: IBM's importance was different. One of the world's most powerful and respected computer companies was entering the personal computer market and giving the technology enormous.

dialogue.text: Credibility.
dialogue.zh: 可信度。
dialogue.ja: 信頼性です。
dialogue.local: Credibility.
dialogue.en: Credibility.

dialogue.text: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.
dialogue.zh: IBM PC是以Intel 8088處理器為核心，運行速度為4.77 MHz。
dialogue.ja: IBM PCはIntel 8088プロセッサを中心に構築され、動作周波数は4.77MHzでした。
dialogue.local: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.
dialogue.en: The IBM PC was built around an Intel 8088, processor running at 477 Mhz.

dialogue.text: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.
dialogue.zh: 其基本配置僅有16KB記憶體，且原始系統甚至沒有包含磁碟機。
dialogue.ja: 基本構成は16キロバイトのメモリだけで、元のシステムにはディスクドライブも含まれていませんでした。
dialogue.local: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.
dialogue.en: Its basic configuration contained only 16 kilobytes of memory, and the original system did not even include a disk drive.

dialogue.text: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.
dialogue.zh: IBM的初始價格為965美元，若加上顯示器、磁碟機和印表機，成本可能增加數千美元。
dialogue.ja: IBMの導入価格は965ドルで、ディスプレイ、ディスケットドライブ、プリンターを追加すると数千ドルの費用がかかりました。
dialogue.local: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.
dialogue.en: IBM's introductory price was $1 for $965 while adding a display, diskette drives, and a printer could add thousands of dollars to the cost.

dialogue.text: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.
dialogue.zh: 以現代標準來看，這台機器非常有限，但在1981年，它代表了商業計算的一個重要新方向。
dialogue.ja: 現代の基準では非常に制限されていましたが、1981年にはビジネスコンピューティングの重要な新しい方向性を示していました。
dialogue.local: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.
dialogue.en: By modern standards, the machine was extremely limited, but in 1981, it represented an important new direction for business computing.

dialogue.text: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.
dialogue.zh: IBM最重要的決定之一是使用開放式架構來打造PC。
dialogue.ja: IBMの最も重要な決定の一つは、PCをオープンアーキテクチャで構築することでした。
dialogue.local: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.
dialogue.en: One of IBM's most important decisions was to build the PC using an open architecture.

dialogue.text: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.
dialogue.zh: 與IBM早期的許多電腦系統不同，該公司大量依賴市售零件，而非自行設計每個部件。
dialogue.ja: IBMの以前の多くのコンピュータシステムとは異なり、同社はすべての部品を自社設計するのではなく、市販の部品に大きく依存しました。
dialogue.local: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.
dialogue.en: Unlike many of IBM's earlier computer systems, the company relied heavily on commercially available components rather than designing every part itself.

dialogue.text: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.
dialogue.zh: 處理器來自Intel，而作業系統則是透過微軟與IBM的合作提供。
dialogue.ja: プロセッサはIntel製で、オペレーティングシステムはMicrosoftとIBMの関係を通じて提供されました。
dialogue.local: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.
dialogue.en: The processor came from Intel, while the operating system was supplied through Microsoft's relationship with IBM.

dialogue.text: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.
dialogue.zh: 系統搭載PC DOS發行，微軟也將作業系統授權為MS-DOS給其他製造商。
dialogue.ja: システムはPC DOSでリリースされ、Microsoftは他のメーカーにもMS-DOSとしてライセンスを供与しました。
dialogue.local: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.
dialogue.en: The system was released with PC DoS, while Microsoft also licensed the operating system as MMS DOS to other manufacturers.

dialogue.text: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.
dialogue.zh: 採用開放式架構的決定帶來巨大影響。IBM公開技術資訊，使其他公司能製造相容的硬體和軟體。
dialogue.ja: オープンアーキテクチャを採用した決定は大きな影響をもたらしました。IBMは技術情報を公開し、他社が互換性のあるハードウェアやソフトウェアを作成できるようにしました。
dialogue.local: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.
dialogue.en: The decision to use an open architecture had enormous consequences. IBM published technical information that allowed other companies to create compatible hardware and software.

dialogue.text: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.
dialogue.zh: 很快，IBM PC周圍形成了一個生態系統。
dialogue.ja: やがて、IBM PCを中心としたエコシステムが発展しました。
dialogue.local: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.
dialogue.en: Soon, an ecosystem developed around the IBM PC.

dialogue.text: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.
dialogue.zh: 公司生產記憶體擴充、周邊設備、軟體，最終還有整套相容電腦。
dialogue.ja: 企業はメモリ拡張、周辺機器、ソフトウェア、そして最終的には完全な互換コンピュータを製造しました。
dialogue.local: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.
dialogue.en: Companies produced memory expansions, peripheral devices, software, and eventually entire compatible computers.

dialogue.text: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.
dialogue.zh: 這造成了IBM PC歷史上的一大諷刺。
dialogue.ja: これはIBMのPCの歴史における大きな皮肉の一つを生み出しました。
dialogue.local: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.
dialogue.en: This created one of the great ironies of IBM's PC history.

dialogue.text: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.
dialogue.zh: IBM協助將該架構建立為產業標準，但同樣的開放性也讓競爭者能打造相容系統。
dialogue.ja: IBMはそのアーキテクチャを業界標準として確立しましたが、同じオープンさが競合他社に互換システムを作らせることになりました。
dialogue.local: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.
dialogue.en: IBM helped establish the architecture as an industry standard, but the same openness allowed competitors to build compatible systems.

dialogue.text: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.
dialogue.zh: 1983年，康柏推出了IBM相容電腦，克隆市場開始成長。
dialogue.ja: 1983年、CompaqはIBM互換のコンピュータを発売し、クローン市場が拡大し始めました。
dialogue.local: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.
dialogue.en: In 1983, Compaq introduced an IBM compatible computer, and the clone market began to grow.

dialogue.text: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.
dialogue.zh: 隨著時間推移，儘管其架構仍具巨大影響力，IBM在PC市場的份額卻下降了。
dialogue.ja: 時間が経つにつれて、IBM自身のPC市場シェアは減少しましたが、そのアーキテクチャの影響力は依然として大きかったです。
dialogue.local: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.
dialogue.en: Over time, IBM's own share of the PC market declined, even though its architecture remained enormously influential.

dialogue.text: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.
dialogue.zh: IBM PC最大的影響可能是在職場上。
dialogue.ja: IBM PCの最大の影響はおそらく職場にありました。
dialogue.local: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.
dialogue.en: The IBM PC's biggest impact was probably in the workplace.

dialogue.text: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.
dialogue.zh: 在個人電腦普及之前，計算通常與大型集中式機器相關，由專家操作。
dialogue.ja: パーソナルコンピュータが普及する前は、コンピューティングは専門家が操作する大型の集中型マシンに関連付けられていました。
dialogue.local: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.
dialogue.en: Before the personal computer became common, computing was often associated with large, centralized machines, operated by specialists.

dialogue.text: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.
dialogue.zh: 個人電腦將計算直接帶到辦公桌上。
dialogue.ja: PCはコンピューティングを直接オフィスの机の上に持ち込みました。
dialogue.local: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.
dialogue.en: The PC brought computing directly onto the office desk.

dialogue.text: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.
dialogue.zh: 員工可以使用電腦進行文字處理、試算表、資料庫、會計、通訊及許多其他工作。
dialogue.ja: 従業員はワードプロセッシング、スプレッドシート、データベース、会計、コミュニケーションなど多くの作業にコンピュータを使えるようになりました。
dialogue.local: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.
dialogue.en: Workers could use computers for word processing, spreadsheets, databases, accounting, communication, and many other tasks.

dialogue.text: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.
dialogue.zh: 個人電腦成為實用的商業工具，而不僅僅是昂貴的技術新奇物。
dialogue.ja: パーソナルコンピュータは単なる高価な技術的好奇心ではなく、実用的なビジネスツールとなりました。
dialogue.local: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.
dialogue.en: The personal computer became a practical business tool, rather than simply an expensive technical curiosity.

dialogue.text: The software ecosystem was equally important.
dialogue.zh: 軟體生態系統同樣重要。
dialogue.ja: ソフトウェアのエコシステムも同様に重要でした。
dialogue.local: The software ecosystem was equally important.
dialogue.en: The software ecosystem was equally important.

dialogue.text: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.
dialogue.zh: IBM PC幫助將MS-DOS介紹給龐大的新用戶群，並促進了大型軟體產業的發展。
dialogue.ja: IBMのPCはMS-DOSを大規模な新しいユーザー層に紹介し、大きなソフトウェア産業の発展に貢献しました。
dialogue.local: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.
dialogue.en: IBM's PC helped introduce MS-DOS to a huge new user base and contributed to the development of a large, software industry.

dialogue.text: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.
dialogue.zh: 發表一年內，已有超過750套軟體可用於IBM PC。
dialogue.ja: 発売から1年以内に、IBM PC向けのソフトウェアパッケージは750以上に達しました。
dialogue.local: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.
dialogue.en: Within a year of the launch, more than 750 software packages were available for the IBM PC.

dialogue.text: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.
dialogue.zh: 這說明了科技歷史中的一個重要原則。
dialogue.ja: これは技術史における重要な原則を示しています。
dialogue.local: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.
dialogue.en: This demonstrates an important principle of technology history.

dialogue.text: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.
dialogue.zh: 單靠硬體，很少能創造技術革命。
dialogue.ja: ハードウェアだけで技術革命を起こすことはほとんどありません。
dialogue.local: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.
dialogue.en: Hardware, alone, rarely creates a technological revolution.

dialogue.text: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.
dialogue.zh: 成功的平台需要軟體開發者、應用程式、配件、用戶及願意投資的企業。
dialogue.ja: 成功するプラットフォームには、ソフトウェア開発者、アプリケーション、アクセサリー、ユーザー、そして投資を惜しまない企業が必要です。
dialogue.local: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.
dialogue.en: A successful platform needs software developers, applications, accessories, users, and businesses willing to invest in it.

dialogue.text: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.
dialogue.zh: IBM PC正是創造了這樣的生態系統。
dialogue.ja: IBM PCはまさにこのようなエコシステムを作り出しました。
dialogue.local: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.
dialogue.en: The IBM PC created exactly this kind of ecosystem.

dialogue.text: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.
dialogue.zh: IBM強大的聲譽也幫助改變了人們對個人電腦的看法。
dialogue.ja: IBMの強力な評判は、パーソナルコンピュータに対する認識を変えるのにも役立ちました。
dialogue.local: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.
dialogue.en: IBM's strong reputation also helped change the perception of personal computers.

dialogue.text: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.
dialogue.zh: 該公司一直與大型商業電腦相關聯，因此其進入PC市場讓許多企業放心，認為個人電腦是嚴肅的工具。
dialogue.ja: 同社は大型ビジネスコンピュータと結びついていたため、PC市場への参入は多くの企業にパーソナルコンピュータが真剣なツールであると安心させました。
dialogue.local: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.
dialogue.en: The company had been associated with large business computers, so its entry into the PC market reassured many businesses that personal computers were serious tools.

dialogue.text: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.
dialogue.zh: 電腦歷史博物館描述IBM PC幫助將個人電腦的形象從類似業餘愛好者的機器轉變為合法的商業工具。
dialogue.ja: コンピュータ歴史博物館は、IBM PCがパーソナルコンピュータの認識をホビイストの機械から正当なビジネスツールへと変えるのに役立ったと説明しています。
dialogue.local: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.
dialogue.en: The computer history museum describes the IBM PC as helping change the perception of the personal computer from something resembling a hobbyist's machine into a legitimate business tool.

dialogue.text: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.
dialogue.zh: 這種影響遠超過IBM本身。
dialogue.ja: その影響はIBM自身をはるかに超えて続きました。
dialogue.local: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.
dialogue.en: The impact continued far beyond IBM itself.

dialogue.text: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.
dialogue.zh: PC架構成為龐大電腦產業的基礎。
dialogue.ja: PCアーキテクチャは巨大なコンピュータ産業の基盤となりました。
dialogue.local: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.
dialogue.en: The PC architecture became a foundation for an enormous computer industry.

dialogue.text: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.
dialogue.zh: 微軟隨著PC生態系統成長，最終將Windows發展成主導的桌面作業系統。
dialogue.ja: MicrosoftはPCエコシステムと共に成長し、最終的にWindowsを支配的なデスクトップOSに発展させました。
dialogue.local: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.
dialogue.en: Microsoft grew alongside the PC ecosystem, eventually developing windows into the dominant desktop operating environment.

dialogue.text: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.
dialogue.zh: 硬體製造商打造相容電腦，軟體公司則創造越來越複雜的應用程式。
dialogue.ja: ハードウェアメーカーは互換コンピュータを製造し、ソフトウェア会社はますます高度なアプリケーションを開発しました。
dialogue.local: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.
dialogue.en: Hardware manufacturers built compatible computers, while software companies created increasingly sophisticated applications.

dialogue.text: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.
dialogue.zh: 到了20世紀末，個人電腦在辦公室、學校和家庭中變得普遍。
dialogue.ja: 20世紀末までに、パーソナルコンピュータはオフィス、学校、家庭で一般的になりました。
dialogue.local: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.
dialogue.en: By the late 20th century, personal computers were becoming common in offices, schools, and homes.

dialogue.text: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.
dialogue.zh: 人們用它們來撰寫文件、計算預算、製作圖形、玩遊戲、學習程式設計、溝通，最終連接網際網路。
dialogue.ja: 人々は文書作成、予算計算、グラフィック作成、ゲーム、プログラミング学習、コミュニケーション、そして最終的にはインターネットアクセスに使っていました。
dialogue.local: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.
dialogue.en: People were using them to write documents, calculate budgets, create graphics, play games, learn programming, communicate, and eventually access the internet.

dialogue.text: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.
dialogue.zh: 從原始的IBM 5150到今天的電腦，變化非常驚人。
dialogue.ja: 元のIBM 5150から今日のコンピュータへの変化は驚異的です。
dialogue.local: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.
dialogue.en: The transformation from the original IBM 5150 to today's computers is extraordinary.

dialogue.text: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.
dialogue.zh: 第一台IBM PC只有16KB記憶體，處理器速度為4.77 MHz。
dialogue.ja: 最初のIBM PCは16キロバイトのメモリしかなく、4.77MHzで動作するプロセッサを搭載していました。
dialogue.local: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.
dialogue.en: The first IBM PC had only 16 co-abed of memory, and a processor running at 4.77 mAhlints.

dialogue.text: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.
dialogue.zh: 現代電腦在許多方面的能力是當時的百萬倍，能處理高解析度影片、大型資料庫、先進圖形和人工智慧工作負載。
dialogue.ja: 現代のコンピュータは多くの面で何百万倍も性能が向上し、高解像度ビデオ、大規模データベース、高度なグラフィックス、人工知能の処理が可能です。
dialogue.local: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.
dialogue.en: Modern computers are millions of times more capable in many respects, and can process high-resolution video, large databases, advanced graphics, and artificial intelligence workloads.

dialogue.text: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.
dialogue.zh: 然而基本概念仍然可辨識，就是將電腦直接放在個人使用者手中。
dialogue.ja: しかし基本的な考え方は変わらず、コンピュータを個人の手に直接置くことです。
dialogue.local: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.
dialogue.en: Yet the basic idea remains recognizable, a computer placed directly in the hands of an individual user.

dialogue.text: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.
dialogue.zh: 因此，1981年8月12日的歷史不僅僅是IBM推出另一台電腦的故事。
dialogue.ja: したがって、1981年8月12日の歴史は単にIBMが別のコンピュータを発売した話ではありません。
dialogue.local: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.
dialogue.en: The history of August 12, 1981, is therefore not simply the story of IBM releasing another computer.

dialogue.text: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.
dialogue.zh: 它代表了計算從專門機構進入日常生活的重要一步。
dialogue.ja: これはコンピューティングが専門機関から日常生活へと移行する大きな一歩を示しています。
dialogue.local: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.
dialogue.en: It represents a major step in the movement of computing from specialized institutions into everyday life.

dialogue.text: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.
dialogue.zh: IBM PC不是第一台個人電腦，但IBM幫助使個人電腦成為主流商業平台。
dialogue.ja: IBM PCは最初のパーソナルコンピュータではありませんが、IBMはパーソナルコンピュータを主流のビジネスプラットフォームにするのを助けました。
dialogue.local: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.
dialogue.en: The IBM PC was not the first personal computer, but IBM helped make the personal computer a mainstream business platform.

dialogue.text: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.
dialogue.zh: 其開放式架構促進了龐大的硬體與軟體生態系統，其品牌則為新興的PC產業帶來合法性，促進採用速度。
dialogue.ja: オープンアーキテクチャは巨大なハードウェアとソフトウェアのエコシステムを促進し、そのブランドは新興のPC産業に正当性を与え、普及を加速させました。
dialogue.local: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.
dialogue.en: Its open architecture encouraged a huge ecosystem of hardware and software, while its brand gave the emerging PC industry a level of legitimacy that helped accelerate adoption.

dialogue.text: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.
dialogue.zh: 從只有16KB記憶體的機器到今日強大的電腦，個人電腦改變了工作、教育、娛樂、通訊和創造力。
dialogue.ja: 16キロバイトのメモリを持つ機械から今日の強力なコンピュータまで、パーソナルコンピュータは仕事、教育、娯楽、コミュニケーション、創造性を変革しました。
dialogue.local: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.
dialogue.en: From a machine with 16 kilobytes of memory to the powerful computers used today, the personal computer has transformed work, education, entertainment, communication, and creativity.

dialogue.text: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
dialogue.zh: 而這場變革中重要的日期之一就是1981年8月12日。
dialogue.ja: そして、その変革の重要な日付の一つが1981年8月12日です。
dialogue.local: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
dialogue.en: And one of the important dates in that transformation is August 12, 1981.
